card.name: Daily and yearly frequency words
card.fires_on: Frequency or time-period words such as daily, annual, day (in "day after day"), and year, often right where a recurring schedule is being named. Also fires on a few nearby tokens, such as the start of "Dose" after "Daily".

modes.label: Daily/annual as a schedule word
modes.description: The word daily, Daily or annual appears at the start of a phrase about regular administration or a yearly index.
modes.example: as part of a comprehensive prevention strategy, including adherence to<< daily>> administration and safer sex practices, including condoms

modes.label: Repeated time units
modes.description: A time unit is repeated or labelled, as in "day after day" or "report year".
modes.example: As the book of Hebrews says, "The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming — not the realities themselves. Day after<< day>> every priest stands and performs his religious duties

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with words meaning every day, every year, or every week, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up on words like daily or annual that name how often something recurs.
